using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
using JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_atom(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_atom_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_red_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_red(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            loss[1] = loss[1] + mapreduce(init = zero(eltype(view(u, 1:i_n))), ((__mr_1, __mr_2)->__mr_1 * __mr_2), +, view(u, 1:i_n), view(v, 1:i_n))
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_red_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end



function bench(f, a, reps)
    for _ in 1:30; f(a...); end          # warm up compilation and caches
    CUDA.synchronize()
    best = Inf
    for _ in 1:5                          # take the best of 5 batches
        t0 = time(); for _ in 1:reps; f(a...); end; CUDA.synchronize()
        best = min(best, (time() - t0) / reps * 1e6)
    end
    return best
end

function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
    tbl = Dict{String,Any}()
    for n in (256, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 262144)
        u = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n)); v = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n))
        ub = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); vb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
        loss = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float64, 1)
        a = (loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, n)
        reps = n > 100000 ? 100 : 300
        ta = bench(dotprod_atom, a, reps)
        tr = bench(dotprod_red,  a, reps)
        tbl["n$(n)"] = Dict("atomic_us" => round(ta, digits = 2),
                            "mapreduce_us" => round(tr, digits = 2),
                            "speedup" => round(ta / tr, digits = 3))
    end
    r["dotprod"] = tbl
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
